init_edge_rot_euler_angles: compute Euler angles (alpha, beta, gamma) from a PyTorch edge distance vector tensor for 3D rotation initialization
wigner_D: compute the Wigner D-matrix for a given angular momentum level and Euler angles using precomputed J matrices
eulers_to_wigner: convert Euler angle tensors into block-diagonal Wigner D-matrices across a range of angular momentum levels
Safeacos: use a numerically stable acos autograd function that clamps inputs to avoid NaN gradients near -1 and 1
Safeatan2: use a numerically stable atan2 autograd function that clamps the denominator to avoid division by zero during backprop
